# Gimble Foundation

> Nonprofit making mental fitness part of everyday life across Africa through technology, education, and community.

Gimble Foundation helps people understand how their minds work and build healthier mental habits through three programs: the Gimble mobile app (guided mental fitness experiences, daily check-ins, practical tools), community and education (online community, virtual events, expert-led conversations), and outreach programs (campus programs, workplace initiatives, community workshops, partnerships).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Mental fitness for everyday life — Gimble Foundation's mission and programs.
- [About](/about): Vision, mission, and the values behind our work.

- [The App](/app): Mental fitness in your pocket — features and download links.
- [Community](/community): Conversations, virtual events, learning sessions, and challenges.
- [Join Us](/get-involved): Volunteer, partner with us, or become an ambassador.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the Gimble Foundation team.
